title.en: Where will I be in five years?

es: Escribir sobre metas a cinco años combinando future perfect, future perfect continuous y un plan que se abandonó.

teaching.en: In five years, I will have finished my degree, and I will be working in a hospital.
teaching.es: En cinco años habré terminado mi carrera y estaré trabajando en un hospital.
teaching.explanationEs: Will have finished: un resultado; will be working: lo que haré en ese momento.
segments: In five years, I will have finished my degree,
and I will be working in a hospital.
teaching.audioText: In five years, I will have finished my degree, and I will be working in a hospital.

teaching.en: By then, I will have been living abroad for two years, so my English will be fluent.
teaching.es: Para entonces llevaré dos años viviendo en el extranjero, así que mi inglés será fluido.
teaching.explanationEs: Will have been living + for: duración hasta ese punto futuro.
segments: By then, I will have been living abroad for
two years, so my English will be fluent.
teaching.audioText: By then, I will have been living abroad for two years, so my English will be fluent.

teaching.en: I was going to study music, but I gave up that dream and chose medicine.
teaching.es: Iba a estudiar música, pero renuncié a ese sueño y elegí medicina.
teaching.explanationEs: Was going to + but + gave up: un plan abandonado.
segments: I was going to study music, but I
gave up that dream and chose medicine.
teaching.audioText: I was going to study music, but I gave up that dream and chose medicine.

teaching.en: By the end of the decade, I will have been saving for a house for four years.
teaching.es: Para finales de la década llevaré cuatro años ahorrando para una casa.
teaching.explanationEs: By the end of + momento futuro, y for + duración.
segments: By the end of the decade, I will have
been saving for a house for four years.
teaching.audioText: By the end of the decade, I will have been saving for a house for four years.

teaching.en: I thought my career would be in music, but now I want to work with animals.
teaching.es: Pensé que mi carrera estaría en la música, pero ahora quiero trabajar con animales.
teaching.explanationEs: Would be: lo que esperaba entonces; but now: cómo cambió.
segments: I thought my career would be in music,
but now I want to work with animals.
teaching.audioText: I thought my career would be in music, but now I want to work with animals.

prompt.es: Completa: «Para entonces llevaré dos años viviendo en el extranjero.»

feedback.es: Después de will have been va el verbo en -ing: living.

hint.es: Después de will have been el verbo termina en -ing.

origin.text: By then, I will have been ___ abroad for two years.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase habla de un plan abandonado?

choices.text: I will move to Spain next year.
I was going to move to Spain, but I gave up the idea.
I have lived in Spain for two years.

feedback.es: Was going to + but + gave up presenta un plan que se dejó; las otras dos hablan de futuro o de presente.

hint.es: Busca el plan que ya no sigue en pie.

prompt.es: Elige la frase: «Para 2030 llevaré cinco años ahorrando.»

choices.text: By 2030, I will save for five years.
By 2030, I have been saving for five years.
By 2030, I will have been saving for five years.

feedback.es: Para medir lo que llevarás haciendo hasta 2030 se usa will have been saving + for.

hint.es: Es una duración medida hasta un punto futuro.

prompt.es: Ordena: «En cinco años habré terminado mi carrera.»

answer.text: In five years I will have finished my degree

feedback.es: Will have finished presenta el resultado que tendrás en cinco años.

prompt.es: Completa las tres frases sobre tus metas.

answer.text: will have finished | will have been living | gave
accepted: will have finished | will have been living | gave

feedback.es: Finish pide un resultado (will have finished); for two years, una duración (will have been living; will have lived también se admite); la última frase habla de un plan ya abandonado (pasado).

sentences: By 2032, I ___ (live) abroad for two years.
I was going to study history, but I ___ (give) up that idea.

prompt.es: Escucha: ¿qué tendrá Carlos dentro de diez años?

choices.text: Eight years as a teacher and a small house.
Eight years as a teacher and a new car.
Two years as a teacher and a small house.

feedback.es: Carlos tendrá ocho años de experiencia como profesor y habrá comprado una casa pequeña.

origin.audio: In ten years, I will have been teaching for eight years, and I will have bought a small house.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué plan abandonó Mia.

feedback.es: Mia dice que iba a ser enfermera y renunció a ese sueño; estudiar arte es su nuevo camino.

origin.audio: I was going to be a nurse, but I gave up that dream. By next year, I will have been studying art for three years.

prompt.es: Completa: «Para el próximo junio, Tom llevará cuatro años tocando la guitarra.»

feedback.es: For four years pide una duración hasta un punto futuro: will have been playing (will have played también se admite).

origin.text: By next June, Tom ___ the guitar for four years.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase une bien lo que pensabas antes y lo que quieres ahora?

choices.text: I thought I will live abroad, but now I want to stay here.
I thought I would living abroad, but now I want to stay here.
I thought I would live abroad, but now I want to stay here.

feedback.es: Con thought el futuro pasa a would + verbo base; will y would living son incorrectos.

prompt.es: Escribe tus metas a cinco años en unas 50 palabras: resultado, duración, plan.

answer.text: In five years, I will have finished my degree. By then, I will have been living abroad for two years, so my English will be fluent. I will have been saving for a house for four years as well. I was going to study music, but I gave up that dream and chose medicine. I want to work in a hospital.
accepted: In five years, I will have finished my degree. By then, I will have been living abroad for two years, so my English will be fluent. I will have been saving for a house for four years as well. I was going to study music, but I gave up that dream and chose medicine. I want to work in a hospital.

In five years, I will have finished my degree. By then, I will have been living abroad for two years, and I will have been saving for a house for four years. I was going to study music, but I gave up that dream. Now I want to work with animals.

By 2031 I will have completed my degree, and I will have been living abroad for two years. I will have been saving for a house for four years as well. I was going to study music, but I changed my mind. It was a difficult decision, but I am happy.

feedback.es: El texto combina un resultado (will have finished), dos duraciones (will have been living, will have been saving + for) y un plan abandonado (was going to… but I gave up).

origin.text: Escribe unas 50 palabras (mínimo 40) sobre tus metas dentro de cinco años: algo que habrás terminado (tu carrera), dos duraciones hasta entonces (llevarás dos años viviendo en el extranjero y cuatro años ahorrando para una casa) y un plan que abandonaste (ibas a estudiar música, pero renunciaste a ese sueño).

prompt.es: Ordena: «Para entonces llevaré diez años ahorrando.»

answer.text: By then I will have been saving for ten years

feedback.es: By then fija el punto futuro y will have been saving + for ten years mide la duración.

prompt.es: Elige la frase correcta: «Pensé que sería médico.»

choices.text: I thought I would be a doctor.
I thought I will be a doctor.
I thought I was being a doctor.

feedback.es: Con un verbo principal en pasado, el futuro pasa a would + verbo base.

prompt.es: Escribe en inglés: para 2030 habrás terminado la carrera.

answer.text: By 2030, I will have finished my degree.
accepted: By 2030, I will have finished my degree.
I will have finished my degree by 2030.

feedback.es: Un resultado hasta un punto futuro se dice con will have finished + by 2030.

origin.text: Meta: para 2030 habrás terminado la carrera.
